brief: Fix OTLP export saturation in server/src/telemetry.ts: reserve one of the four concurrent export slots for the invoke_agent root span. Count skipped exports in an exportDropped counter. All six local spans must still be written when five tool spans followed by a root are offered to a saturated exporter; export three tools and the root. Do not install dependencies or modify tests, Git configuration or HEAD.

criteria.testName: a saturated OTLP exporter keeps a slot for the root and counts what it skips
